sections.title: 5.3.3 Microscopic Findings
sections.text: Microscopic examination was performed on all animals. Group 1 (0 mg/kg/day) showed no treatment-related findings. Group 2 (20 mg/kg/day) showed no treatment-related findings. Group 3 (60 mg/kg/day) showed centrilobular hepatocellular necrosis, grade 3, in 7 of 10 animals, with associated inflammatory infiltrate and elevated transaminases. Group 4 (180 mg/kg/day) showed centrilobular hepatocellular necrosis, grade 4, in 9 of 10 animals.

sections.title: 5.3.4 Conclusion
sections.text: The no-observed-adverse-effect level (NOAEL) for Compound HX-052 under the conditions of this study is **60 mg/kg/day**. The lowest-observed-adverse-effect level (LOAEL) is **180 mg/kg/day**, based on hepatocellular necrosis observed at that dose.
